effects: Moves previewRedeem(shares) USDe from the vault to the silo and adds it to the signer's pending cooldown amount.
Resets the signer's cooldownEnd to now + cooldownDuration for the whole pending amount, including USDe from earlier cooldowns.
The signer can claim the USDe only later, with unstake, after the cooldown ends.
formats.shown: Intent 'Cooldown Shares' and one field 'Amount' with the sUSDe share amount.

findings.title: cooldownShares restarts the cooldown timer for all USDe the signer already has pending; nothing shown says so.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownShares: `cooldowns[msg.sender].cooldownEnd = uint104(block.timestamp) + cooldownDuration; cooldowns[msg.sender].underlyingAmount += uint152(assets);` The timer is per account, so earlier pending USDe is locked again for up to 90 days (MAX_COOLDOWN_DURATION). Descriptor shows only intent 'Cooldown Shares' and 'Amount'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Unstake sUSDe; restarts any pending cooldown' or add a notice that the cooldown resets for all pending USDe.

findings.title: cooldownShares intent 'Cooldown Shares' is jargon and does not say sUSDe is burned and USDe locked.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "intent": "Cooldown Shares", field label "Amount"; code `_withdraw(msg.sender, address(silo), msg.sender, assets, shares)` burns sUSDe and sends USDe to the silo.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Start sUSDe unstake cooldown' and interpolatedIntent 'Unstake {shares} and lock USDe for cooldown'. Label the field 'sUSDe to unstake'.

findings.title: cooldownShares does not show the USDe amount locked or the cooldown length; both come from storage.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownShares: `assets = previewRedeem(shares);` and `cooldownDuration` is a storage value. Case 0: 1,853,468.8 USDe moved to silo 0x7fc7…3425 for the signer, not shown.

cases.notes: sUSDe out 1,515,266.44 shown with the right token. USDe 1,853,468.8 moved to the silo for the signer's cooldown is not shown (storage-derived).

effects: Burns previewWithdraw(assets) sUSDe from the signer (rounded up).
Moves `assets` USDe from the vault to the silo and adds it to the signer's pending cooldown amount.
Resets the signer's cooldownEnd to now + cooldownDuration for the whole pending amount, including earlier cooldowns.
The signer can claim the USDe only later, with unstake.
formats.shown: Intent 'Cooldown Assets' and one field 'Amount' with the USDe amount.

findings.title: cooldownAssets restarts the cooldown timer for all USDe the signer already has pending; nothing shown says so.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownAssets: `cooldowns[msg.sender].cooldownEnd = uint104(block.timestamp) + cooldownDuration; cooldowns[msg.sender].underlyingAmount += uint152(assets);` Descriptor shows only 'Cooldown Assets' and 'Amount'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Unstake sUSDe; restarts any pending cooldown' or add a notice about the reset.

findings.title: cooldownAssets never names sUSDe as the asset that leaves; only a USDe amount is shown.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.cooldownAssets: `shares = previewWithdraw(assets); ... _withdraw(msg.sender, address(silo), msg.sender, assets, shares);` burns sUSDe. Descriptor: intent "Cooldown Assets", field "Amount" with token 0x4c9EDD…68B3 (USDe).
findings.fix: Use intent 'Unstake sUSDe for USDe (cooldown)' and label the field 'USDe to unstake'. interpolatedIntent: 'Unstake sUSDe worth {assets}'.

findings.title: cooldownAssets cannot show the sUSDe amount burned; the vault rate in storage decides it.

effects: Sends the signer's full pending cooldown USDe (cooldowns[msg.sender].underlyingAmount) from the silo to `receiver`.
Clears the signer's cooldown position (amount and end time set to 0).
No sUSDe leaves the signer's wallet.
formats.shown: Intent 'Unstake' and one field 'Receiver' with the address.

findings.title: unstake intent 'Unstake' suggests staked tokens leave; it only claims cooled-down USDe and names no asset.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.unstake: `silo.withdraw(receiver, assets);` sends USDe only. Case 1: only effect is USDe 377.27 in; reader believed sUSDe leaves the wallet and was unsure which token arrives.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Claim unstaked USDe' and add interpolatedIntent 'Claim all cooled-down USDe to {receiver}'.

findings.title: unstake does not show the USDe amount claimed; it is the full pending amount in storage.
findings.evidence: StakedUSDeV2.unstake: `uint256 assets = userCooldown.underlyingAmount;` Case 1: USDe 377.267452233234854718 in, amount not on screen.

findings.title: unstake Receiver uses addressName types eoa and wallet; the code accepts any address, contracts included.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "types": ["eoa","wallet"]; StakedUSDeV2.unstake(address receiver) has no restriction on receiver.
findings.fix: Remove the types restriction or add "contract".

cases.notes: USDe 377.27 in. Screen shows the receiver only; no asset or amount. Reader guessed USDe, no amount, and wrongly expected sUSDe to leave.
